app.name: Descargador Bombastic
page.downloads.subtitle: Paste links and download video or audio with yt-dlp.
page.queue.subtitle: Running and pending downloads and edits.
page.editor.subtitle: Convert, trim and edit video and audio with ffmpeg.
page.history.subtitle: Everything you have downloaded and edited.
page.library.subtitle: Saved option sets and commands.
page.settings.subtitle: Language, theme, folders and dependencies.
page.placeholder: This section will be available in development phase {phase}.
downloads.input.placeholder: Paste one or more links here (one per line or separated by spaces)
downloads.add.tooltip: Add the links to the list (Ctrl+Enter)
downloads.add.none: No links were found in the text.
downloads.add.duplicates: Those links were already in the list.
downloads.embed_subs.tooltip: Stores the subtitles offered by the site inside the video. Video only.
downloads.embed_extras.tooltip: Adds the thumbnail as cover art plus title, author and date to the file.
downloads.warning.no_ytdlp: yt-dlp was not found, so nothing can be downloaded. Copy it into the binaries folder (Settings → Dependencies).
downloads.warning.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg was not found: video and audio cannot be merged or converted to other formats. Copy it into the binaries folder (Settings → Dependencies).
downloads.list.empty: No links yet. Paste one above and press “Add links”.
downloads.error.exit_code: yt-dlp exited with code {detail} without giving a reason
downloads.error.timeout: yt-dlp took too long to respond
downloads.error.bad_info: yt-dlp returned a response that could not be understood
downloads.confirm_exit.title: Download in progress
downloads.confirm_exit.text: There are downloads in progress. If you quit now they will be paused and you can resume them next time. Quit?
settings.browse.title: Choose download folder
settings.dependencies.hint: If one is missing, copy the executable into the binaries folder. Automatic download will arrive with the dependency wizard.
settings.data.portable: Portable mode: data is stored next to the executable.
settings.shortcuts.downloads: Ctrl+Enter: add the pasted links (in Downloads)
downloads.sent_to_queue: Sent to the Queue. You can follow its progress there (Ctrl+2).
downloads.error.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg is missing: install it from Settings → Dependencies
downloads.error.js_runtime: yt-dlp needs Deno for this site: install it (Settings → Dependencies)
downloads.error.age: The video is age-restricted: try enabling cookies
downloads.error.bot_check: The site asks to confirm you are not a bot: try enabling cookies
downloads.error.members: Members only: enable cookies from an account with access
downloads.error.login: You need to sign in: try enabling cookies
downloads.error.geo: This video is not available in your country
downloads.error.copyright: The video was taken down for copyright reasons
downloads.error.not_started: The live stream or premiere has not started yet
downloads.error.unsupported: This site is not supported by yt-dlp
downloads.error.format: The requested format is not available for this video
downloads.error.rate_limited: The site is rate-limiting downloads: wait a while and retry
downloads.error.forbidden: The site denied access (403): updating yt-dlp usually fixes it
downloads.error.unavailable: The video is unavailable or was removed
queue.empty: The queue is empty. Add links in Downloads and press Download.
queue.log.title: Download log
queue.command.title: yt-dlp command
settings.auto_retries.tooltip: How many times a download that fails with a network error is retried automatically
settings.rate_limit.tooltip: Maximum speed per download, in bytes per second, with K, M or G. Empty = no limit.
downloads.card.formats.tooltip: See the available formats and pick video and audio by hand
downloads.format_chosen: Chosen format: {spec}. It will be used when downloading this link.
downloads.conflict.extract_without_ffmpe: Extracting audio needs ffmpeg and it was not found.
downloads.conflict.merge_with_audio: --merge-output-format has no effect with an audio-only format.
downloads.conflict.output_overridden: -o or -P replace the app's folder or file name.
advanced.title: Advanced yt-dlp options
advanced.search: Search by name, flag or description…
advanced.extra_args.unbalanced: There are unclosed quotes: the extra arguments will not be used until fixed.
advanced.cookies.explain: Cookies let you download videos that require signing in, are age-restricted or members-only. They are off by default. With Chrome and Edge you may need to close the browser before downloading.
formats.title: Available formats
formats.hint: Pick a video format and, if it has no audio, an audio format. The app builds the -f and merges both tracks with ffmpeg.
settings.catalog.refresh.tooltip: Re-reads the advanced mode option list from the installed yt-dlp
settings.catalog.failed: Could not read yt-dlp's help; using the bundled list
player.play.tooltip: Play or pause (Space). Arrows: ±1 s; Shift+arrows: ±5 s; comma and period: frame by frame
player.mark_in.tooltip: Marks the start of the range at the current point
player.mark_out.tooltip: Marks the end of the range at the current point
editor.open.tooltip: You can also drag a video or audio file onto this page
editor.no_file: No file open. Open it or drag it here.
editor.probe_failed.missing: ffprobe not found: install it from Settings → Dependencies.
editor.probe_failed.unreadable: Cannot read {name}: it does not look like a valid video or audio file.
editor.queued: Added to the edit queue: {name}. Follow it in Queue → Edits.
editor.convert.copy_hint: "Copy without re-encoding" (-c copy) is instant and lossless, but only works if the new container supports the current codecs. Re-encoding is slower and lets you change codec, quality and size.
editor.convert.can_copy: This file can be copied to this container without re-encoding.
editor.trim.fast_hint: Fast mode: no re-encoding, but it cuts at the nearest keyframe, so the start may be a few seconds early.
editor.trim.precise_hint: Precise mode: cuts exactly at the given times, re-encoding to H.264/AAC. Takes longer.
editor.segments.mode.keep: Keep these ranges and join them
editor.segments.hint: Mark a range with I and O in the player and press "Add marked range". Repeat for each range.
editor.concat.need_two: Add at least two files. Drag to change the order.
editor.concat.compatible: The files are compatible: they will be joined without re-encoding (fast and lossless).
editor.concat.recode: The files differ: they will be re-encoded to the first one's resolution (slower).
editor.compress.crf_hint: 28 usually gives small files with acceptable quality; 23 is close to the original.
editor.compress.size_hint: {kbps} kbps of video will be used in two passes.
editor.error.bad_range: The end time must be after the start time.
editor.error.no_duration: The file's duration is unknown: use quality-based compression.
editor.queue.empty: No edits. Open a file in the Editor and add a tool to the queue.
editor.preview.tooltip: Renders 10 seconds of the result (from the in marker or the current point) and plays them, without processing the whole file
editor.preview.failed: The preview could not be rendered. Use "View command" to check the options.
editor.preview.unavailable: This tool has no preview (two passes, snapshots or joining files).
editor.proxy.working: The player cannot open this format: creating a lightweight copy for the preview…
editor.proxy.ready: Previewing a lightweight copy (H.264 480p). The tools use the original file.
editor.proxy.failed: The preview copy could not be created; the tools still work.
editor.transform.hint: Cropping is applied before resizing. Use "Preview result" to check it.
editor.speed.hint: 2x is twice as fast and 0.5x half speed. Audio is adjusted without changing the pitch.
editor.audio.op.adjust: Volume, fades, channels and sample rate
editor.audio.hint.extract: Saves only the audio in the chosen format.
editor.audio.hint.remove: Leaves the video without sound, without re-encoding.
editor.audio.hint.replace: Uses the audio from another file. The result lasts as long as the shorter of the two.
editor.audio.hint.adjust: Changes volume (in dB), adds fades and converts channels or sample rate. The video is copied as is.
editor.audio.hint.normalize: Measures loudness in a first pass and adjusts it to the target in the second. -16 LUFS is common online; -14 for music platforms.
editor.subs.mode.embed: Embed as a track (can be turned on or off)
editor.subs.hint.embed: Fast and lossless: the video is not re-encoded.
editor.subs.hint.burn: Re-encodes the video to draw the subtitles on the picture.
editor.subs.hint.extract: Saves the first subtitle track as .srt.
editor.animation.hint: Uses the range marked with I and O (or 5 seconds from the start). GIFs are heavy: prefer short, narrow ranges.
editor.snapshot.mode.current: The frame at the current point
editor.metadata.title: Title
editor.metadata.hint: Empty fields are kept. Nothing is re-encoded.
editor.error.needs_video: This tool needs a file with video.
editor.error.cover_audio_only: Cover art can only be set on audio files.
editor.error.analysis: the first pass did not return the loudness measurements
settings.hw.found: Working: {names}. If an edit fails with acceleration, it is retried on the CPU automatically.
settings.hw.none: No working hardware acceleration found; the CPU will be used.
settings.hw.hint: Speeds up H.264 and H.265 with the graphics card. Press "Detect" to see what is available.
editor.open_expert.tooltip: Sends this tool's command to expert mode to tweak it by hand
expert.hint: Write any ffmpeg command (without "ffmpeg" in front). Variables: {input}, {inputs[1]}, {output}, {start}, {end} (I/O markers), {dir}, {name} and your own parameters such as {crf}. The command must include {output}.
expert.filters.title: ffmpeg filters
expert.filters.empty: The filter list could not be retrieved (is ffmpeg missing?).
expert.save.title: Save recipe
expert.save.name: Name
expert.save.favorite: Favorite (shows in the Explorer context menu)
expert.error.unknown_variable: Unknown variable: add it to the parameters.
expert.error.missing_input: An extra input is missing for that variable.
expert.error.empty_variable: A variable is empty (are the I/O markers missing?).
expert.error.quotes: There are unclosed quotes in the command.
expert.error.bad_file: The file has no valid recipes.
library.recipes.empty: No recipes. Save one from Editor → Expert.
history.column.title: Title
history.clear.confirm: Delete the whole history? Downloaded files are not touched.
library.profiles.empty: No profiles. Save them from Downloads → "Save as profile…".
settings.download_archive: Avoid downloading the same thing twice
settings.download_archive.tooltip: Uses --download-archive with a file managed by the app: anything already downloaded is skipped.
